slides.summary: Kenya's Sheldrick Wildlife Trust keeper Misheck spent five months without a day off caring for Wangalla, a week-old elephant calf found hiding among zebras after lions scattered her herd.
slides.headline: Keeper spends five months caring for orphaned elephant calf
slides.proves: Misheck's five months of near-constant care show a week-old orphaned elephant can be brought back to a stable, social life in a sanctuary.

slides.summary: Kazakhstan's Kok-Aral Dam increased the northern Aral Sea's water volume 68%, halved its salinity and more than tripled fish production, while Uzbekistan planted 4.2 million acres of the exposed lakebed.
slides.headline: Dam increases northern Aral Sea water volume by 68 percent
slides.proves: A single dam project can partly reverse the shrinking of a major inland sea within a few years.

slides.summary: Burkina Faso's malaria vaccine rollout helped cut recorded cases by 32% and malaria deaths by 44% between 2024 and 2025.
slides.headline: Malaria vaccine rollout cuts cases by 32 percent
slides.proves: Burkina Faso's combined vaccination and prevention program shows a country can nearly halve malaria deaths within two years.

slides.summary: Researchers at NHS Blood and Transplant traced the rare AnWj blood antigen to the MAL gene, solving a mystery open since 1972 and creating a new blood group system.

slides.proves: This discovery lets blood banks genetically screen for the extremely rare AnWj negative donors who were previously nearly impossible to identify.

slides.headline: Foundation commits 250 million dollars to veterinary care
slides.proves: Dave and Cheryl Duffield's gift shows a single foundation can fund a five year national fix for the 50 million pet care gap the Foundation identified.
